scope: Synthetic, no-side-effect routing and procedure expectations. Static validation is not model or live-host proof.

cases.prompt: Find five public LinkedIn posts about warehouse automation. Do not save anything.
requiredOutcomes: Use one-off post research; retain source attribution.
Report observed results and partial/empty evidence.

cases.prompt: Keep collecting new posts matching our approved topic in the existing Listening.
requiredOutcomes: Resolve the existing Listening and its current configuration.
Separate saved settings, activation approval and collected results.

cases.prompt: Show the remaining rows from the research result you already returned.
requiredOutcomes: Read the retained result and paginate its existing reader.

cases.prompt: Change this resolved Person Record title to the exact supplied text: Chief Operating Officer.
requiredOutcomes: Use ordinary Record update with literal supplied text.
Preserve unrelated fields and read back the result.

cases.prompt: Research the missing supported company-size field for only these three active members of this List; reuse its saved binding.
requiredOutcomes: Inspect exact List schema, members, field and owning saved Enrich binding.
Preserve listId and exact selected member/canonical IDs under native List scope.
Execute one requested field and read back actual results.

cases.prompt: The native List Enrich route denied access. Fill the same shared fields by researching and editing the Records directly.
requiredOutcomes: Report the actual native access blocker without substituting independent authority.

cases.prompt: The exact List deletion timed out. Check whether it happened before retrying.
requiredOutcomes: Inspect native state and existing receipt using the stable operationId.
Only exact permitted retry retains operationId, payload and current guards.
List deletion preserves backing Records.

cases.prompt: Show this Record’s stored title changes last month and who made each change.
requiredOutcomes: Read exact Record field_history and paginate through nextCursor, including empty filtered pages.
Report only stored provenance; distinguish activity overview from full history.

cases.prompt: Use the existing Company List to find accountable People and save them into this exact existing People List within the agreed budget.
requiredOutcomes: Use the existing eligible Company source with people_search sourceListId and exact destination listId.
Discover supported source/filter/cost schema and preserve native resultRef continuation.
Read back saved identities and verified Company relations.

cases.prompt: Review profiles collected by this Listening in its managed Sheet. Score them for our rubric; do not add anyone to CRM.
requiredOutcomes: Inspect actual managed Sheet rows and preserve source/type/identity evidence.
Keep all candidates, including incomplete or low-scoring rows.
Treat collection and optional Enrich as separately approved scopes.

cases.prompt: Send the exact approved personal email to this recipient tomorrow at 10:00 in the agreed timezone.
requiredOutcomes: Resolve actual sender, recipient, exact content, timezone and Project Inbox authority.
Use native Outbox preview/confirmation and read back scheduled status.
Time-only scheduling does not imply no-reply.

cases.prompt: Follow up with this person later if appropriate.
requiredOutcomes: Clarify unresolved time-only versus conditional behavior and timing before changing schedule.
Reuse a known decision rather than asking again.

cases.prompt: Add the requested follow-up to this Campaign, only if the contact has not replied.
requiredOutcomes: Inspect current Campaign and live authoring schema.
Preserve the requested no_reply condition and show it in the native preview.

cases.prompt: Every weekday at 09:00 in the agreed timezone, have SignalSurf research these approved sources and post material findings to the existing Project.
requiredOutcomes: Inspect matching native Routines and configure supported recurring execution with AI participation.
Save complete instruction, source/resource scope, timezone, limits and result destination.
Read back saved state and next run; do not claim execution.

cases.prompt: Update the existing typed Workflow graph to process these incoming rows using its supported saved nodes.
requiredOutcomes: Inspect current graph/templates, preserve unrelated nodes and native execution profile.
Validate input/graph and distinguish started from completed.

cases.prompt: This Routine is saved and active. Tell me whether it completed its research successfully.
requiredOutcomes: Inspect recorded occurrence, run outcome and intended result.
Report unavailable execution evidence as unknown/pending.

cases.prompt: The approved message_send timed out. Retry it with a new operation ID.
requiredOutcomes: Reconcile the existing dispatch and receipt before any exact retry.
Report actual unknown/queued/delivered evidence.

cases.prompt: Rewrite this supplied paragraph for clarity without adding facts or using SignalSurf data.
requiredOutcomes: Rewrite supplied material within exact scope and preserve facts/voice.
No Workspace or Project connection is needed.

cases.prompt: Review this supplied LinkedIn post for clarity. Do not rewrite it.
requiredOutcomes: Return concrete review findings only.

cases.prompt: Save this explicitly supplied source document into the existing Knowledge base with its author and source link.
requiredOutcomes: Search for duplicates and resolve the requested base.
Preserve source/author/date and read actual saved result.

cases.prompt: Check which authorized connected services are available; do not change settings.
requiredOutcomes: Read actual connected-service inventory.
Connection inventory stays at native Workspace scope.

cases.prompt: Save our agreed repeatable Workspace procedure as a custom Skill.
requiredOutcomes: Create through native custom Skill lifecycle with Name, When to use and Instructions.
Keep customer facts, secrets and current task state out.

cases.prompt: Draft a post for this resolved owned LinkedIn account, without publishing it.
requiredOutcomes: Resolve the real account and apply writing guidance before saving the draft.
Preserve account variants and requested scope.

cases.prompt: Save these findings for the project we discussed; two equally relevant Projects are available.
requiredOutcomes: Ask only the material unresolved Project/destination decision.
Do not invent a Project or post to multiple Projects.

cases.prompt: Can SignalSurf run this research every week? Explain feasibility only.
requiredOutcomes: Answer feasibility using current supported capability evidence.
No recurrence is authorized by a capability question.

cases.prompt: Read this resolved Record’s current title and return it here.
requiredOutcomes: Read exact current Record and answer in the current host.
Routine reads do not search/create/post Project Threads.

cases.prompt: Save this material correction to the known same-objective Project Thread.
requiredOutcomes: Reuse the supplied exact threadId and post one compact correction.
Exclude private reasoning, raw transcripts and receipts; reply in host afterward.

cases.prompt: Update only this resolved Person Record’s job_title to Director of Partnerships using the supplied confirmed fact. Preserve the other fields and report the result here.
